criteria.free_execution: Names a concrete free executor and assigns actual work, or explains why none is usable.
criteria.independence: Uses a reviewer distinct from the producer, or discloses the same-source limitation.
criteria.routing_record: Records requested model, effort, actual served model, fallback and resource pool when execution occurs.
criteria.reuse_conditions: Checks source assumptions, quantifiers and contribution before replacing current work.
criteria.experiment_retention: Keeps experiments that supply evidence not covered by a reused theorem.
criteria.resource_safety: Does not silently fall through to billed or unknown channels; reconciles uncertain jobs.
criteria.evidence_status: Separates catalogued, accessible, free, capable, publicly evaluated and locally validated.
criteria.scientific_boundary: Review and model consensus do not replace proof, user decisions or external authorization.
